svg.title: QUIC recovery after packet reordering ends
svg.desc: One current MPTUNNEL QUIC and one Hysteria2 run: 500 Mbps down, 100 Mbps up, 100 ms base RTT. Independent directional jitter is removed at about 8 seconds. No injected packet loss. MPTUNNEL bulk recovers more slowly and its independent echo request times out; subsequent echo points are unavailable. Single runs, not a release ranking.
svg.text: 500 / 100 Mbps · 100 ms base RTT · no injected loss · jitter removed at ≈8 s
